diff --git a/django/core/exceptions.py b/django/core/exceptions.py
index dc084b8692..f23973ca67 100644
--- a/django/core/exceptions.py
+++ b/django/core/exceptions.py
@@ -182,6 +182,15 @@ class ValidationError(Exception):
     def __repr__(self):
         return 'ValidationError(%s)' % self
 
+    def __eq__(self, other):
+        if not isinstance(other, ValidationError):
+            return NotImplemented
+        if hasattr(self, 'error_dict') and hasattr(other, 'error_dict'):
+            return sorted(self.message_dict.items()) == sorted(other.message_dict.items())
+        if hasattr(self, 'error_dict') or hasattr(other, 'error_dict'):
+            return False
+        return sorted(self.messages) == sorted(other.messages)
+
 
 class EmptyResultSet(Exception):
     """A database query predicate is impossible."""
diff --git a/tests/test_exceptions/test_validation_error.py b/tests/test_exceptions/test_validation_error.py
index a0bbfaf77e..fb91e9cd7a 100644
--- a/tests/test_exceptions/test_validation_error.py
+++ b/tests/test_exceptions/test_validation_error.py
@@ -14,3 +14,27 @@ class TestValidationError(unittest.TestCase):
         message_dict['field2'] = ['E3', 'E4']
         exception = ValidationError(message_dict)
         self.assertEqual(sorted(exception.messages), ['E1', 'E2', 'E3', 'E4'])
+
+    def test_eq_single_message(self):
+        self.assertEqual(ValidationError('E1'), ValidationError('E1'))
+        self.assertNotEqual(ValidationError('E1'), ValidationError('E2'))
+
+    def test_eq_list_messages_order_independent(self):
+        self.assertEqual(ValidationError(['E1', 'E2']), ValidationError(['E2', 'E1']))
+        self.assertNotEqual(ValidationError(['E1', 'E2']), ValidationError(['E1', 'E3']))
+
+    def test_eq_dict_messages_order_independent(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            ValidationError({'field1': ['E1', 'E2'], 'field2': ['E3']}),
+            ValidationError({'field2': ['E3'], 'field1': ['E2', 'E1']})
+        )
+        self.assertNotEqual(
+            ValidationError({'field1': ['E1']}),
+            ValidationError({'field1': ['E2']})
+        )
+
+    def test_eq_dict_vs_list_not_equal(self):
+        self.assertNotEqual(ValidationError({'field1': ['E1']}), ValidationError(['E1']))
+
+    def test_eq_with_non_validation_error(self):
+        self.assertNotEqual(ValidationError('E1'), 'E1')
